description: ACT-SEL-01, deciding variants: repeated equal keys and an index. Sk (index IX_Sk_V on V) and Sk2 (no index) hold (ID, V) = (1,10), (2,20), (3,20), (4,20), (5,30), (6,30), (7,5). On each runs UPDATE SET V = V + 100 WHERE V BETWEEN 10 AND 30, then UPDATE SET V = V - 100 WHERE V >= 100, then UPDATE SET V = V + 5 WHERE V >= 10, with dbFailOnError; RecordsAffected and the rows after each statement. Follow-up probe (status F) for ACT-SEL-01; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
